t: This is number 3 Robert Street, a building in Westminster. Like its neighbours at numbers 1 and 2, it was designed by the Adams. Robert Adam was a Scottish neoclassical architect, interior designer and furniture designer, trained by his father William. James, his younger brother and partner, was also an architect and furniture designer, though often overshadowed by Robert. William was Scotland's foremost architect of his time, and his exuberant style built on the Palladian, with Baroque details inspired by Vanbrugh and Continental architecture.
